epic.summary: Cash Settlement based on Average Price

business_context: Change the way P/L is calculated for FX Spot instruments from FIFO to average price, with configuration-driven rules for instrument types and downstream metrics (average fill, open P/L, % P/L gross, realized P/L in cash settlement).

synthesis.problem_gist: Epic moves FX Spot (and related) P/L from FIFO to weighted-average costing using configurable per-instrument-type rules; Confluence requirements define FIFO vs WeightedAvg split, average fill, open P/L, % P/L gross, and weighted-average behavior for cash settlement including realized P/L.

requirements.snippet_text: Average Price, Open PL and Realized PL during cash settlement (for non-equity cash flow) are calculated by weighted average for the instrument types configured accordingly in . The Weighted Average algorithm assumes that PL for each closing trade for the whole history of a position should be calculated based on average position price and not the opening price of the matched opening trades. Only opening trades contributes to position average price. See rounding rules: for average price calculation - for realized PL - Example the following position history from the moment the position was flat (zero size): 1) BUY +10 @ 99.00 => position: long 10 2) BUY +10 @ 98.00 => position: long 20 3a) SELL -20 @ 99.50 => position: 0 3b) SELL -10 @ 99.50 => position: short 10 4) SELL -10 @ 98.50 => position: short 20 5a) BUY +10 @ 97.25 => position: short 10 5b) BUY +15 @ 98 => position: long 5 6) BUY +10 @ 99.50 => position: long 15 Average price and PL calculations for each point: Trade sequence Trade side Trade size Trade price Position net size Position average price Realized PL Effect
